During the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], there were a series of '''H-shaped space stations''' that were in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as for civilian purposes.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

Such stations included the [[Corellia Space Station]] and the [[Talus Station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], the [[Dantooine Space Station]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]], the [[Dathomir Station]] and the [[Last Nav Station]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]], the [[Endor Space Station]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], the [[Lok Station]] in the [[Karthakk system]], the [[Naboo Space Station]] and the [[Rori Space Station]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], the [[Tatooine Space Station]] and the [[Station-Star 1]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], the [[Yavin 4 Space Station]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> the [[Kashyyyk Space Station]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> and the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]<ref name="SWG:SK" /> and [[Nova Orion Station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA" />

A decorative scale model of the space station was supplied during [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] and [[Remembrance Day]] by both the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA" />
